thread:
Jordan: Quick idea 1
Jordan: Quick idea - shrink the weekly triage to 25 minutes and push any >7m design/RFC items to a biweekly deep-dive. Wed 10:30 PT seems to cover US+EU best. Thoughts?

Jordan: My proposed 25m layout:
```
- 3m: quick system/alerts highlights
- 8m: owner one-liners (status | blocker | ask)
- 10m: top-5 bug triage (risk: low/med/high + owner)
- 4m: actions & next owners
```

Neha: +1 to shorter weekly. One-liner owners sounds great 44d. Can we require top-5 posted in the thread by Tue COB so we actually move fast?

Lee: Agree. Also: put a persistent "backlog board" link in the invite and ask PRs to use label `triage:discuss` if they want the call to weigh in.

Tanya: Recording for APAC is fine. Can we add a 1-line risk tag next to bugs (low/med/high) — helps triage quickly. Also, biweekly deep-dive should be 40-45m for RFCs.

Jordan: Yes to risk tags and recording. New rule: if any topic needs >7m, move to async thread or biweekly deep-dive. I'll make the deep-dive alternate Fridays, 45m.

triage-bot: Calendar update: weekly-triage Wed 10:30 PT (25m). Biweekly deep-dive Fri 45m starting in two weeks. Recording ON. Join: https://meet.redwood/triage

Neha: Small ops ask: can the invite show two tiny health numbers in the description so people scan before joining? e.g. active-critical-bugs: N | blocked-deploys: M.

Lee: I'll pin the backlog link and update the invite with placeholders for the top-5. Volunteering to own week of Apr 14 and will post top-5 by Tue.

Tanya: Rotation idea: alphabetical owner rotation with swaps allowed via DM. Predictable and easy to plan time off.

Jordan: Sounds fair. I'll set alphabetical rotation, add the owner one-line template to the triage doc, and update the recurring invite. Also adding a "last action owner" column to the board per Neha's request.

Lee: For PRs, add `triage:discuss` or `triage:review` — whichever you prefer — so we can filter quickly.

Neha: One more: owners, include a 1-line estimated ETA for your next action (helps follow-ups).

Jordan: OK: owner template = "status | blocker | ask | risk | ETA". I'll paste it into the triage doc and invite. If anyone needs to swap weeks DM me.

triage-bot: Reminder: weekly-triage pinned in calendar. Recording ON. https://calendar.redwood/triage

Tanya: Thanks all. I'll post the first deep-dive agenda in the #eng calendar once scheduled.

Lee: Posting top-5 tomorrow. See you Wed.

Jordan: Thanks team. Closing thread :rocket:
